ex.en: I am hungry because I did not eat breakfast.
ex.zh: 我沒吃早餐，所以肚子很餓。

ex.en: I'm pretty hungry. When can we go have lunch?
ex.zh: 我好餓，什麼時候可以去吃午餐？

ex.en: When I got home, I was very hungry.
ex.zh: 我回到家時肚子非常餓。

ex.en: The young team is hungry for success.
ex.zh: 這支年輕的團隊渴望成功。

ex.en: She is hungry for new challenges at work.
ex.zh: 她渴望在工作上接受新挑戰。

ex.en: After the hurricane, their house was a wreck.
ex.zh: 颶風過後，他們的房子成了一片廢墟。

ex.en: The hurricane caused many flights to be cancelled.
ex.zh: 颶風導致許多航班取消。

ex.en: Singapore is a major shipping hub.
ex.zh: 新加坡是主要的航運樞紐。

ex.en: The city is a hub for tech start-ups.
ex.zh: 這座城市是科技新創公司的聚集中心。

ex.en: Connect the printer to the USB hub.
ex.zh: 把印表機接到 USB 集線器上。

ex.en: The network hub needs to be replaced.
ex.zh: 網路集線器需要更換。

ex.en: The event was hugely successful.
ex.zh: 這場活動非常成功。

ex.en: Her new book is hugely popular.
ex.zh: 她的新書非常受歡迎。

ex.en: Funding is the biggest hurdle for the project.
ex.zh: 資金是這個專案最大的難關。

ex.en: We cleared the final hurdle and got approval.
ex.zh: 我們通過了最後一道關卡，拿到核准。

ex.en: The temperature of the human body hovers around 37°C.
ex.zh: 人體溫度大約在攝氏 37 度上下。

ex.en: Needless to say, fundamental human rights should be respected.
ex.zh: 不用說，基本人權應該受到尊重。

ex.en: Humans are the only animals that can use fire.
ex.zh: 人類是唯一會用火的動物。

ex.en: People used to think that only humans could use language.
ex.zh: 以前人們認為只有人類會使用語言。

ex.en: It's not possible for humans to live forever.
ex.zh: 人不可能長生不死。

ex.en: He will be a good husband to my sister.
ex.zh: 他會是我妹妹的好丈夫。

ex.en: He's making it clear that he's an ideal husband.
ex.zh: 他擺明了自己是理想的丈夫。

ex.en: More and more women have their own careers and are economically independent of their husbands.
ex.zh: 越來越多女性擁有自己的事業，經濟上不必依賴丈夫。

ex.en: A huge tanker just pulled out from the dock.
ex.zh: 一艘巨大的油輪剛駛離碼頭。

ex.en: We arrived to find a huge meal ready for us.
ex.zh: 我們到達時，發現一頓豐盛的大餐已經準備好了。

ex.en: The new product was a huge success.
ex.zh: 新產品大獲成功。

ex.en: Roger slipped on the ice and hurt his leg.
ex.zh: 羅傑在冰上滑倒，摔傷了腿。

ex.en: A hundred people were hurt in a train wreck.
ex.zh: 一百人在火車事故中受傷。

ex.en: If your tooth hurts, you should see a dentist.
ex.zh: 如果你牙齒痛，就該去看牙醫。

ex.en: My head hurts. Maybe I should take an aspirin.
ex.zh: 我頭好痛，也許該吃顆阿斯匹靈。

ex.en: My calf has been hurting since yesterday.
ex.zh: 我的小腿從昨天開始一直痛。

ex.en: Afraid of hurting his feelings, I didn't tell him the truth.
ex.zh: 我怕傷了他的心，所以沒告訴他真相。

ex.en: The bad weather hurt sales this month.
ex.zh: 壞天氣影響了本月的銷售。

ex.en: He likes to hunt.
ex.zh: 他喜歡打獵。

ex.en: Tom and Mary went deer hunting.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗去獵鹿了。

ex.en: We're hunting for a new apartment.
ex.zh: 我們正在找新公寓。

ex.en: She spent months hunting for a job.
ex.zh: 她花了好幾個月找工作。

ex.en: The job hunt took me six months.
ex.zh: 我找工作找了六個月。

ex.en: The hunt for a new CEO has begun.
ex.zh: 尋找新執行長的工作已經展開。

ex.en: Our teacher has a wonderful sense of humor.
ex.zh: 我們老師非常有幽默感。

ex.en: You have a good sense of humor.
ex.zh: 你很有幽默感。

ex.en: It is a pity that he has no sense of humor.
ex.zh: 可惜他一點幽默感都沒有。

ex.en: I didn't agree, but I humored him.
ex.zh: 我並不同意，但還是順著他。

ex.en: Just humor her and say yes.
ex.zh: 就順著她的意思答應吧。

ex.en: I hurried in order to catch the first train.
ex.zh: 我趕著去搭第一班火車。

ex.en: If you hurry, you will catch up with him.
ex.zh: 如果你快一點，就能追上他。

ex.en: Don't hurry me. I need time to think.
ex.zh: 別催我，我需要時間想一想。

ex.en: Hurry up, or you will miss the last train.
ex.zh: 快一點，不然你會趕不上末班車。

ex.en: Hurry up! The movie starts in five minutes.
ex.zh: 快點！電影五分鐘後就開始了。

hurry.zh: 匆忙、急忙（常用 in a hurry）

ex.en: She was in a hurry to see her father.
ex.zh: 她急著去見她父親。

ex.en: Sorry, I'm in a hurry right now.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我現在趕時間。

ex.en: There's no hurry; you can send it tomorrow.
ex.zh: 不急，你明天再寄就好。

ex.en: Many people are suffering from hunger around the world.
ex.zh: 世界上有許多人正在挨餓。

ex.en: Millions of people die of hunger each year.
ex.zh: 每年有數百萬人死於飢餓。

ex.en: Let's eat now. I'm dying of hunger.
ex.zh: 我們現在吃吧，我快餓死了。

ex.en: She has a real hunger for success.
ex.zh: 她非常渴望成功。

ex.en: His hunger for knowledge never stopped.
ex.zh: 他對知識的渴求從未停止。

ex.en: Summer in Taipei is very hot and humid!
ex.zh: 台北的夏天又熱又潮濕！

ex.en: Hot and humid weather makes us lazy.
ex.zh: 炎熱潮溼的天氣使我們變得懶散。

ex.en: It is less humid today than it was yesterday.
ex.zh: 今天沒有昨天那麼潮濕。

ex.en: The humidity in Taiwan makes summer feel hotter.
ex.zh: 台灣的濕度讓夏天感覺更熱。

ex.en: Today's humidity is about 85%.
ex.zh: 今天的濕度約 85%。

ex.en: Music is a common speech for humanity.
ex.zh: 音樂是人類共通的語言。

ex.en: Cancer is a great enemy of humanity.
ex.zh: 癌症是人類的大敵。

ex.en: Slavery is a crime against humanity.
ex.zh: 奴役制是一種危害人類罪。

ex.en: The doctor treated every patient with humanity and respect.
ex.zh: 那位醫生以人道和尊重的態度對待每位病人。

ex.en: The soldier showed great humanity toward the prisoners.
ex.zh: 那名士兵對俘虜展現了極大的人道精神。

ex.en: I didn't want to humiliate you.
ex.zh: 我不是想要羞辱你。

ex.en: The coach humiliated the player in front of the whole team.
ex.zh: 教練當著全隊的面羞辱那名球員。

ex.en: He humorously described his first day at work.
ex.zh: 他幽默地描述自己上班的第一天。

ex.en: The book humorously explains how to survive a family dinner.
ex.zh: 這本書用幽默的筆法說明如何撐過家庭聚餐。

ex.en: He still remembers the humiliation of failing in front of his class.
ex.zh: 他仍記得在全班面前失敗的羞辱。

ex.en: The team suffered a humiliation in a 10-0 defeat.
ex.zh: 球隊以 0 比 10 慘敗，備受羞辱。
